description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called GatewayDiscoveryDebugLogView that displays, in a list, discovery debug logs from a network gateway controller, including timestamped messages and a copy button to export logs.

methods.name: formattedLog
methods.description: Concatenates discovery debug log entries into a single string with timestamps.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a Date into a HH:mm:ss string.

methods.name: formatISO
methods.description: Formats a Date into an ISO8601 string with fractional seconds.
